cell_line.evidence: Briefly, J774 cells seeded on 24-well plates were labeled with [3H]-cholesterol overnight and then stimulated with 0.3 mmol/L cyclic AMP for 15-17 hours to up-regulate ABCA1 transporters.

For hepatic cholesterol uptake, Fu5AH rat hepatoma cells were seeded on 24-well plates in growth media for 2 days before being washed with MEM-HEPES/0.5% bovine serum albumin and the CEC-conditioned medium applied to cells (triplicate wells).

cell_type.evidence: Cholesterol efflux capacity (CEC) and hepatocyte uptake were assessed using patient serum in ex vivo cell-based assays.

disease_state.evidence: To investigate the effect of apoA-I [human] (CSL112) infusion on HDL protein composition, and provide further insights into the mechanism of action of CSL112 administered post-acute myocardial infarction (AMI).

material_type.evidence: HDL was immuno-isolated from patient plasma using anti-apoA-I antibodies.

sample_source.evidence: HDL was immuno-isolated from patient plasma using anti-apoA-I antibodies.
